meta.title: Image and video generation
meta.description: Create high-resolution images and short videos with sound from a single sentence. Supports text-to-image, image editing, text-to-video, first/last-frame image-to-video, and multi-reference video for posters, product images, creative shorts, and more. Results are saved locally. First use requires a wylon API key (get one at https://dashboard.wylon.cn); usage is billed to your wylon account.
